We need to find a template that matches the retrosynthetic step: target molecule is given SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

This is a sulfonamide: aromatic amine attached to sulfonyl group with phenylsulfonyl chloride originally. The retrosynthetic step: break N-S bond (sulfonamide) to give amine (aromatic amine) and sulfonyl chloride (phenylsulfonyl chloride). So functional groups formed in forward: sulfonamide (N-S) formed, S-Cl broken. So broken functional group: sulfonyl chloride? Actually forward reaction: aromatic amine attacks electrophilic sulfur of phenylsulfonyl chloride, then collapse expels Cl- and base deprotonates N-H to give sulfonamide. So forward: S-Cl bond broken, N-S bond formed, also maybe HCl eliminated. So for retrosynthesis, we need template that breaks N-S bond and forms S-Cl bond (i.e., reverse). So we search template catalog with functional_groups_broken = ["sulfonamide"]? Wait broken in forward: sulfonamide formed, so broken in forward is S-Cl. So we set functional_groups_broken = ["sulfonyl chloride"]? The functional groups list likely includes "sulfonyl chloride". Let's get list.
We need to call get_available_functional_groups.
